summary: Ritlecitinib carries the strongest type of FDA warning for serious infections, death, cancer, major heart problems, and blood clots [3]. Official warnings also note risks of severe allergic reactions and low blood sugar in people with diabetes [3]. Based on a small computer model rather than tests on people, the drug received a high risk score of 66 for the liver and a low risk score of 21 for the heart [M].
